profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer @ Oracle
profile.summary: Software Engineer in a love-love relationship with React and NodeJS. Developing serverless form submissions for e-commerce sites. Contributing to several projects with a history of clean, modular and scalable code. I enjoy working in an Agile environment and meeting deadlines. When I’m not working, I like to go sing Karaoke with friends.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Building the future of MultiCloud. 
Enabling customers to use Oracle Database @ Microsoft Azure, AWS and GCP.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Leading the design efforts for the new music licensing marketplace utilizing React/Redux and NextJS. 
- Architecture search and discovery experience that enables users to navigate library with 300K+ tracks.
- Engage in collaborative processes to oversee and navigate teams' development process 
- Create quick and responsive UI with a11y and performance in mind. 
- Increase performance and SEO metrics through SSR.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contribute to a revolving set of clients’ products. Add features and maintain deployment on
an as-needed basis.

• Implement multi-threading on a Python server by incorporating a queueing system and
load-balancing, enabling 400 analysts to connect and interact concurrently with an AI
engine
• Create, design, and deploy a Markdown Converter application using React and
NodeJS. Product managers and developers use the app to transform any text into
most available markdown/markup formats, which has reduced time spent drafting emails,
Jira tasks, and documentation by 40%
• Contribute to the development of self-hosting orchestration/cloud deployment tool similar to
AWS Elastic Container Service. Add a feature to use GitHub/GitLab repository as an
image source. Add default and customizable liveness, readiness, and startup probes to
ensure efficient use of server resources
• Develop a serverless automation job using AWS lambda to check CRM databases and
send email notifications to the sales team about hot and expiring leads
• Design and execute several real estate CRM integrations for a global property
management software. Add a synchronized flow to enable property management to be
in control of repair/request tickets from tenants and then delegate the work to a
contractor database
• Add multiple framework implementations for TechEmpower Framework Benchmarks
projects, including Apple’s ServiceTalk library

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed a performant backend using micro-service architecture to improve load speeds by 64%
• Engineered raw SQL queries to process enterprise-grade data analytics without increasing latency
• Decreased error rate and improved scalability by combining server-side rendering with NGINX load balancing and caching
